interpretation.reason: This historical run is useful as a failure baseline, not as evidence of production-ready legal quality.

claim_boundaries: Do not convert missing faithfulness/relevance measurements into zero-quality claims; they were not meaningfully evaluated in this run.
Do not use the 53/53 citation-resolution suite as a proxy for end-to-end legal answer accuracy.
Do not claim YPOG-ready legal quality until a larger lawyer-reviewed benchmark passes the release gates.
